properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 25 at 10:51AM MDT until October 27 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Catastrophic flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected along the San Juan River between Four Corners and Mexican
Hat. This is an emergency situation!

* WHERE...Western Montezuma County in southwestern Colorado...
Southern San Juan County in southeastern Utah...

* WHEN...Until 600 AM MDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Major flooding along San Juan River is occurring or
expected to begin shortly. The crest will occur around Aneth,
Montezuma Creek and Bluff this afternoon and evening.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1034 AM MDT, At 9:30 AM MDT Sunday the stage for the San Juan
river near Bluff was 19.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage this
afternoon to a crest of 43.6 feet early Monday morning. It will
then fall below flood stage early Tuesday morning.
- Flood stage is 23.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 32.0
feet on 09/10/1927.
- Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mexican Hat, Tselakai Dezza, Bluff, Halchita, Montezuma Creek and
Aneth.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 25 at 5:14AM MST until October 26 at 12:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding along the Little Colorado River from earlier
excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...The Little Colorado River from Winslow to Leupp.

* WHEN...Until midnight MST tonight /100 AM MDT Monday/.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Little Colorado River is occurring near
Birdsprings. Deadly flooding over low-water crossings.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 513 AM MST /613 AM MDT/, water levels have crested at Winslow
and are expected to continue to fall today. However, downstream
impacts will continue near Birdsprings through the remainder of
the day.
- For Little Colorado at Winslow:
At 5:00am MST /6:00am MDT/ the stage was 17.93 feet.
Flood Stage is 19.0 feet.
Forecast: Water levels will continue to fall through the day,
falling below action stage later this afternoon.
Impacts:
At 17.0 feet: Downstream, the approaches to the bridge over the
river on Navajo Route 71 near Bird Springs will flood, and Leupp
will be within 3 feet of flooding problems. The river will crest
at Navajo Route 71 approximately 18 hours after the river crests
at Winslow. Minor lowland overflow on right bank at Winslow.
At 18.0 feet: Flow above this level for approximately 6 hours or
more may cause erosion to the levee and eventual leakage or
failure.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.
properties.instruction:
Stay away or be swept away! The banks of creeks and washes are
unstable and unsafe during any flooding event.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.
